subject: Draft MAP + evaluation sprint — kickoff materials and timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + evaluation sprint — kickoff materials and timeline

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we sketched for HorizonAI to align on required milestones, owners, and a compact evaluation sprint. The two files in this email are: a co-edit GDoc (HorizonAI_MAP_DRAFT.gdoc) and a short kickoff slide deck (MAP_Kickoff_Slides_v1.pptx).

High level asks in the doc:
- Confirm the 30/60/90 objectives under "Acceptance Criteria" (page 2 of the doc).
- Populate the internal stakeholders section with your procurement and security contacts so we can loop relevant teams.
- Pick preferred dates for a 1-hour kickoff + demo (we've suggested Oct 6 or Oct 8).

Proposed timeline (subject to your procurement window):
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment checklist
- Week 1–2: Pilot integration (data/workload smoke tests)
- Week 3: Evaluation & acceptance gate (sample workloads + latency/cost targets)

If procurement needs a single consolidated SOW/pricing sheet I can attach that in the next email — cc'ing Marissa (CS) and Jasmine (solutions) to keep the internal owners in sync.

Links/attachments: HorizonAI_MAP_DRAFT.gdoc (Google Doc - coedit) | MAP_Kickoff_Slides_v1.pptx (slides)

Next step: If Oct 6 works, I’ll lock a 10am PT slot and share the calendar invite and the GDoc with edit rights.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(attachment: HorizonAI_MAP_DRAFT.gdoc)
(attachment: MAP_Kickoff_Slides_v1.pptx)

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@horizonai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@horizonai.com>
Date: 2025-09-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + evaluation sprint — kickoff materials and timeline

Ben — thanks for sending. The MAP looks promising and the milestones map roughly to our internal priorities. A few items procurement/security asked me to confirm before we lock dates: 

1) Can you provide a one-page commercial summary (pricing band for a 30-day pilot + trial credits and typical post-pilot commit ranges)? Procurement wants the SOW template and an estimate to share with finance.
2) Do you have a short security evidence pack we can ship to our security team (SOC2 scope, retention, KMS details)? If not, procurement looped in here and will request via secure link.
3) We prefer a compressed pilot — start Oct 6, with an evaluation gate on Oct 24 (two-week active pilot + validation week). Is that feasible?

I’ve attached a short procurement intake form (procurement_intake.xlsx) and cc'd our procurement mailbox so they can pick this up. Once you send the summary + evidence link we’ll expedite internal approvals.

On dates: Oct 6 at 10am PT should work for the kickoff. Please send calendar invite and GDoc link with edit rights for my team.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Director, Product 
HorizonAI
(attachment: procurement_intake.xlsx)
